rust_summary: A server player toggled an entity's age lock (`native_player_toggle_entity_age_lock`).
doc_summary: A server player used a golden dandelion on an ageable mob: `native_player_toggle_entity_age_lock(player, name, entity_id, locked)` fires after the lock and item use changed. Bundles need "hooks": @API:player_toggle_entity_age_lock@.
